# Task curation fixtures

The three `.tar.gz` archives preserve representative CodeNet and TaskTrove math source tasks for conversion and grader-binding tests. [`nemotron_ultra/`](nemotron_ultra/README.md) holds JSON rows for source-specific Ultra contracts. Tests load these files as local inputs; they do not stand in for a complete source sample.

See the [test directory](../README.md) for the suites that use these fixtures.
